plan: My value is $9. At price $8.5, staying in would only yield $0.5 profit if I win, but continuing risks paying more than my value. Since price is close to my value, minimal upside remains, and risk of losing money increases. Dropping out avoids potential negative profit.

At $39.5, staying in risks the price rising to $40, matching my value exactly (zero profit) or higher (negative profit). Since I can't guarantee winning below $40, dropping out now avoids potential loss while ensuring zero profit.
